properties.description_es: Departamento amueblado en renta en planta baja del exclusivo residencial Long Island Midtown, Cancún. 115 m² de construcción, 3 recámaras (la principal con baño privado y walk-in closet), 2 baños completos. Cocina completamente equipada integrada con sala y comedor. Aire acondicionado y cortinas black out en toda la propiedad. Centro de lavado con lava-secadora y estacionamiento techado para 2 autos. El residencial ofrece alberca semiolímpica y chapoteadero, terrazas con asoleaderos y juegos infantiles.
properties.description_en: Furnished ground-floor apartment for rent in the exclusive Long Island Midtown residential community, Cancún. 115 sqm built, 3 bedrooms (primary with private bathroom and walk-in closet), 2 full bathrooms. Fully equipped kitchen integrated with living/dining area. A/C and blackout curtains throughout. Laundry room with washer-dryer and covered parking for 2 cars. Community offers semi-Olympic pool with splash area, sundeck terraces and playground.
